_note: Story 068 (owner playtest 5: feeling stuck). When the client asks something, a small 'waiting for' line shows her question (up to questionMaxChars). A miss is her asking to hear it again (sayAgain patterns, case-insensitive) or the player's reply graded 'Try this'. After missesForHelp misses on the same question the companion opens with her tip (or a hint with a ready line). After missesBeforeDefault misses the client picks a sensible answer herself and moves on (the next turn tells the AI so), with a gentle stuckMood dip.
